newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish finance dept no comment on Nordbanken.
newsitem.headline: Swedish finance dept no comment on Nordbanken.

text.p: Swedish commercial bank S-E-Banken and state-controlled Swedish bank Nordbanken are expected to merge this week, Swedish business magazine Affarsvarlden said on Wednesday.
The magazine is the third Swedish media to report such a merger in a week.
"Sources told the Affarsvarlden that a merger between S-E-Banken and Nordbanken will be revealed in the middle of this week," the Affarsvarlden said.
The finance department, however, declined to comment on its plans for the state's stake in Nordbanken. The state controls 59 percent of the bank.
"We have absolutely no comment on Nordbanken when it comes to a timetable or our opinion," finance department spokeswoman Barbara Ericsson told Reuters.
Earlier Ericsson said rumours about a bank merger were pure speculation.
